title: Taking an auxiliary prefix
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a\le K$, and let an assignment give a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each of $K$ auxiliary coordinates. Its prefix of length $a$ assigns to each of the first $a$ coordinates the same sign as the original assignment.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of signs to $K$ auxiliary coordinates
